notes: All three GRU checkpoints are frozen; no training or parameter updates occur.
Predicted z at target step t is produced at t-1 and is therefore causal.
Prediction residual at step t compares the t-1 forecast with the observed z at t.
Scoring starts at step 25 so every readout has a full post-calibration 10-step moving window.
Normalized lifetime is used only for descriptive evaluation.
